place.description: Type a country name and choose a match. Confirm to open the searchable city picker. The first use downloads the GeoNames city catalogue.

city_result.title: Choose city
city_result.description: Each result includes city, region, exact coordinates and time zone. Only the selected city supplies coordinates.

city_picker.title: Choose city
city_picker.description:
Type a city name to filter matches immediately. Each result includes coordinates and time zone. For small places outside the catalogue, type the full name and confirm to search. City coordinates refer to its centre; use manual mode for an exact roof position.
